final_answer.key_evidence_summary: adservice is the sole outlier in namespace boutique: Deployment 'adservice' shows 0/1 READY, 1 UP-TO-DATE, 0 AVAILABLE while all other 10 deployments are 1/1/1; its Service endpoint list is empty (all other services have IP:port endpoints) and CheckServiceConnectivity(adservice:9555) fails. Pod adservice-7b9d8c87cf-gpwlc reports Ready=False with Restart Count 0 and no OOMKilled/termination state, and the only Warning event is 'Readiness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.1.39:9556" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' (x10 over 80s). GetAppYAML shows readinessProbe grpc port 9556 while containerPort/env PORT/Service targetPort are all 9555, and livenessProbe is on 9555. Main class AdService.java only binds the single PORT (9555) and logs 'Ad Service started, listening on 9555' with gRPC health registered on that same server, so nothing ever listens on 9556. Consequence chain closed: probe times out -> pod Never Ready -> removed from Endpoints -> frontend logs 244 occurrences of 'failed to get ads: rpc error: code = Unavailable ... dial tcp 10.68.122.252:9555: connect: connection refused'. Because the liveness probe targets the correct port and the restart count is 0 with no kill events, the break is isolated to the readiness probe port, not to liveness or memory limits.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: boutique 
  labels:
    app: adservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: adservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: adservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: adservice
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/adservice:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9555
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "9555"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 180Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 300Mi
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 9556
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 9555

  labels:

  selector:
    app: adservice
  ports:
  - name: grpc
    port: 9555
